method: Original pure functions extracted directly and compared with TypeScript using Node stripping/VM. Relative/absolute tolerance 1e-9. Published heater/exchanger/membrane rows and twelve economics cases compared for unchanged fields. Intentional corrections excluded: wet-basis excess air/loss output, inert CO2/SO2 contributions and dependent heat-balance outputs, zero-fuel row, exchanger duty comparison on invalid F. These have independent Phase 1 tests. All nine furnace passes use corrected-projection checks, not historical equivalence. Blower comparison covers representative pure-function inputs. This is not a complete equivalence proof.
